specAmbiguitiesResolved: Incident: PAUSED->ESCALATED and REOPENED->ESCALATED are not listed, so they are rejected (resume or triage first). 'Any active' for ESCALATED = DETECTED..VERIFYING.
Service job: the table literally lists SCHEDULED->SCHEDULED and RESCHEDULED->RESCHEDULED; both self-edges kept as specified.
Attempt transport: no edge leaves UNKNOWN/ACKNOWLEDGED/DEFINITE_NO_EFFECT; resolution after UNKNOWN is recorded on the external-outcome and economic axes only.
Recovery plan: EXECUTING -> INVALIDATED is an edge whose guard carries the IN_FLIGHT_RECONCILIATION obligation; it is not a separate state. HELD and REJECTED have no outgoing edges.
Device health: ONLINE->OFFLINE direct is not drawn, so it must pass through STALE.

Temperature: CORE-CONTRACT asks for a 'tested decimal library'; implemented with exact bigint rational arithmetic (no new dependency) and a single half-even rounding to milli-degrees, labelled ROUNDED_HALF_EVEN, with the exact source decimal and unit retained.

Money wire format: amountMinor decodes from a canonical decimal string or a safe-integer number (API example uses a number) and always encodes as a string; bounded to signed int64; ISO 4217 whitelist with exponents (unknown codes rejected).
Identifiers: prefixed opaque '<prefix>_<4..64 of [A-Za-z0-9-]>' (e.g. ten_, inc_, cin_); newId() uses a UUID body.

Digests: '<domain>.v<N>:sha256:<hex>' with '<domain>.v<N>\n' inside the preimage; canonical text sorts keys and encodes bigint as digits+'n'. The action descriptor bound into the digest is {kind, subjectId, quantity, partNumber, manufacturer}.
Execution reference signature algorithm is not named by the spec; HMAC-SHA256 over a versioned canonical preimage was chosen, key supplied by the caller.
The fake requires a CONFIRMED Kite session for the authority before reserve (TDD section 10).
unresolvedRisks: Kite may settle in a non-ISO asset (e.g. a stablecoin with 6 decimals); CurrencyCodeSchema is ISO 4217 only, so M09 must extend the currency table deliberately (a contract change) if that is needed.
The ActionDescriptor field set is M01's choice; M06/M08 may need more bound fields, which requires bumping ACTION_DIGEST_VERSION rather than editing v1.
Only seven event payloads are typed here (plus commercial_intent.state_changed.v1 in kite-contracts); owning modules must define the rest with defineDomainEvent.
The domain and kite-contracts packages import node:crypto, so they are server-side only; @uptimebuyer/contracts is runtime-neutral.
